lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | Command                                                          | What it does                                                                                                                                  |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende review [--base <ref>] [--head <ref>] --data <file>` | Writes a review skeleton for `base...head` with one entry per changed file. The base defaults to `origin/HEAD`, then `main` or `master`.      |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende digest --base <ref> --head <ref>`                   | Prints how many batches to read, a size guess, and one line per changed file: kind, hunks, and symbols. A directory of renames gets one line. |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende show --batch <n>`                                   | Prints batch n of the changed files to read, with old and new line numbers. Each batch fits one agent tool result.                            |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende show --hunk <path@oldStart+newStart>`               | Prints the patch for one hunk or file (`--file <path>`), with old and new line numbers.                                                       |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: drop directory drafts from pregroup
lines.text: | `comprehende pregroup --base <ref> --head <ref> --data <file>`   | Writes a draft review that already groups repeated changes and mechanical files, with a size guess.                                           |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende validate --data <file>`                             | Checks that every hunk ref points into live git and that every hunk is in a group.                                                            |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende serve --data <file>`                                | Serves the UI on a local URL.                                                                                                                 |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende export --data <file> --out <dir>`                   | Writes a static copy of the UI that any static file server can host.                                                                          |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: CLI: show --batch, directory drafts, and a size guess
lines.text: | `comprehende refresh --data <file>`                              | Moves a review to new commits. Keeps unchanged hunks in their groups and puts new hunks in a draft group.                                     |
